review:
Savage Buffalo Spirit Megaways brings the buffalo onto a Megaways grid, with an extra horizontal reel above the main reels to add more ways to win. The buffalo wild carries a 2x multiplier whenever it appears.

During free spins, a multiplier between 2x and 25x is chosen at random and applied to every winning combination for the whole round, so the opening draw sets the tone of the bonus. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a 6,000x maximum and a 96.75% RTP. Free spins arrive more often than in the original, around once every 136 spins on average.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
